blocks.title: Rectification
blocks.text: Rectification alternating current ko direct current mein badalne ka amal hai.

Diodes current ko aik simt (forward bias) mein guzarne dete lekin ulti simt (reverse bias) mein rokte hain. Rectification do qism ki hai, half-wave aur full-wave. Yeh un electronic aalaat mein use hoti hai jinhein mustahkam DC supply chahiye, jaise computers aur smartphones, kyunke zyada tar gharelu aur tijarati bijli AC hai. Forward bias par diode bara current guzarta, jab ke reverse bias diode se current amalan sifar hai; yahi khasiyat diode ko alternating current ko aik-rukhi (direct) current mein badalne deti hai.
Half-wave rectifier

Half-wave rectification mein AC signal aik aadha chakkar guzar kar aur doosra rok kar pulsating DC mein badalta hai. T period ka alternating voltage (transformer ke zariye) load resistance RL ke saath series mein diode D par lagaya jata hai (Fig 17.13). Musbat aadhe chakkar (0 se T/2) mein diode forward bias hai, bohat kam resistance deta, aur RL se current guzarta, jis se us par input ke mutabiq voltage banta hai. Manfi aadhe chakkar (T/2 se T) mein diode reverse bias hai, bohat zyada resistance deta, aur amalan koi current nahi guzarta, is liye RL par voltage taqreeban sifar hai. Yahi har chakkar dohraya jata hai. RL se current sirf aik simt mein behta hai, is liye direct current hai, lekin jhatkon (pulses) mein. Ghar mein backup ke liye use hone wale UPS mein rectifier aur battery charger battery ko chalate hain, aur inverter battery ke DC ko wapas AC banata hai (Fig 17.13 a, kitab mein block diagram).

blocks.alt: Oopar: transformer diode D (forward resistance rf) aur load resistor RL ko series mein deta hai; current I, load current Idc aur output voltage Vdc nishan zada. Neeche baen: AC voltage input signal, 0, 90 aur 180 darje. Neeche daen: DC voltage output signal; musbat aadhe chakkar guzarte (conducting) aur manfi aadhe chakkaron mein output sifar (cut off).
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13: Half-wave rectifier ka kaam, input aur output waves graph par (kitab ki Figure 17.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke output graph mein manfi aadhe chakkar bhi bane hain, halanke diode unhein rok deta hai. Durust output un hisson mein sifar hai; khaake mein yeh hisse sirf halki dashed lakeer se dikhaye gaye hain ke input kya tha. Load mein current sirf aik simt mein, jhatkon (pulses) mein, behta hai.

blocks.alt: Block diagram: 220 V AC rectifier mein, phir battery, phir inverter aur aakhir mein AC appliance. Rectifier ke neeche battery charger us ka output le kar battery ko deta hai. Note: rectifiers are used in UPS at homes for backup power.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13 (a): Hamare gharon mein use hone wale UPS ka circuit view (kitab ki Figure 17.13 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bijli aane par rectifier AC ko DC banata hai aur charger battery bharta hai. Bijli jane par battery ki DC inverter mein ja kar dobara AC ban jati hai aur appliance chalta rehta hai.
Full-wave rectification

Full-wave rectification mein alternating input ke dono aadhe chakkar load se aik-rukhi current ban jate hain. Yeh bridge rectifier se hota hai, jis mein chaar diodes D1 se D4 band chakkar ya 'pul' (bridge) ki shakal mein jure hote hain (Fig 17.15 a). AC supply mukhalif konon ke aik jore (A aur B) se aur load doosre jore se jura hota hai; diodes series jore mein kaam karte hain, har aadhe chakkar mein sirf do current guzarte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar diodes D1 se D4 ka bridge; konay A (oopar) aur B (neeche) AC source V se jure; baqi do konay load R par +V aur 0V dete, darmiyan DC output. Current I source se A ki taraf aur B se wapas, aur +V lakeer par load ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (a): Chaar diodes aur load resistance wala full-wave bridge rectifier circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Musbat aadha chakkar (0 se T/2): terminal A, B ke muqable musbat hai. Diodes D1 aur D2 forward bias ho kar series mein current guzarte, jab ke D3 aur D4 reverse bias hain; current load se guzarta hai (Fig 17.15 b).

Manfi aadha chakkar (T/2 se T): terminal A manfi aur B musbat hai. Ab D3 aur D4 series mein current guzarte jab ke D1 aur D2 band hain. Load se current pehle wali simt hi mein behta hai (Fig 17.15 c).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: input wave, 0 se 4 pi. Oopar daen: teen output pattiyan: D1 aur D2 conducting (pehle aur teesre aadhe chakkar mein pulse), D3 aur D4 conducting (doosre aur chauthe mein), aur final output jis mein har aadhe chakkar mein pulse. Neeche: musbat aadhe chakkar (0 se T/2, D1 aur D2, sabz teer) aur manfi aadhe chakkar (T/2 se T, D3 aur D4, gulabi teer) mein bridge; dono dafa load R mein current neeche ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (b), (c): Full-wave bridge rectifier musbat aur manfi aadhe chakkaron mein, input aur output waves ke saath (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (b), (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke graphs par 'Half wave Bridge rectifier' likha hai aur mehwar par pi, 2 pi barabar faasle par nahi. Yeh full-wave bridge rectifier hai: har aadhe chakkar mein do diodes chalte hain aur load mein current hamesha aik hi simt mein jata hai, is liye final output mein har aadhe chakkar ka pulse hai.

Yun input ke dono aadhe chakkar load se aik-rukhi current bhejte hain. Output hamwar nahi balke pulsating hai; ise capacitors wale filter circuit se hamwar kiya ja sakta hai. Mobile phone chargers aam taur par deewar ke socket ke AC ko battery charge karne ke liye darkaar DC mein badalne ke liye full-wave bridge rectifier use karte hain (Fig 17.16; chhote bridge rectifiers do AC aur do DC siron wale aik package mein aate hain).

blocks.alt: Mains input step-down transformer se guzarta hai jis ki secondary (oopar +, neeche -) chaar diodes ke bridge ko deti hai. Chalne wale do diodes gulabi hain aur gulabi lakeer current I ko un se aur load se neeche earth tak dikhati hai. Chhote khaake AC input (aik aadha chakkar surkh) aur 0 V ke oopar full-wave output (pehla pulse surkh) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.16 (a): Mobile charger mein full-wave bridge rectifier ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.16 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Smoothing capacitor ke saath full-wave bridge rectifier

Rectified output pulsating DC hai, jo zyada tar electronic aalaat ke liye munasib nahi. Smoothing filters AC hisse (ripple) kam karte hain. Capacitor filter mein capacitor load ke parallel jura hota hai: rectified voltage barhne par yeh charge hota aur voltage girne par load mein discharge ho kar output hamwar karta hai (Fig 17.17). Yeh smoothing (reservoir) capacitor zakhire ki tarah kaam kar ke aust DC output bhi barhata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: full-wave bridge rectifier (D1 se D4, A aur B par AC source) aur +V aur 0 V ke darmiyan load R ke aar-paar smoothing capacitor C; sabz teer aik aadhe chakkar aur surkh teer doosre mein current dikhate. Neeche: nateeja wave; capacitor ke baghair dashed pulses, aur capacitor ke saath Vdc ke qareeb taqreeban seedhi lakeer jo C charge hone par uthti aur discharge hone par aahista girti hai, chhota ripple chhorti.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.17: Smoothing capacitor rectifier ke full-wave ripple wale output ko hamwar DC voltage mein badalta hai (kitab ki Figure 17.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure par 'Soothing capacitor' aur 'Wafeform' chhapa hai, aur dono teeron par 'with capacitor' likha hai. Durust: smoothing capacitor; oopar wali mazboot lakeer capacitor ke saath ki wave hai aur dashed pulses capacitor ke baghair ki. Pulse ke dauran C charge hota hai, pulses ke darmiyan load ko current de kar aahista discharge hota hai.

Smoothing capacitor wale full-wave bridge rectifier ka ripple voltage Vripple = IDC / (f_ripple C) = IDC / (2fC) hai, jahan IDC amperes mein load current, f input frequency aur C farads mein capacitance hai. Ripple frequency input frequency ki dugni hai: f_ripple = 2f. Yun zyada capacitance ya kam load current kam ripple deta hai.

blocks.title: Ripple C par munhasir hai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke zyada se zyada ripple voltage 'smoothing capacitor ki qeemat se nahi balke frequency aur load current se tay hota hai', aur phir Vripple = IDC/(2fC) deti hai jis mein C hai. Formula durust hai: ripple capacitance par bhi aur frequency aur load current par bhi munhasir hai.
Hal shuda misal (izafi)

50 Hz supply par full-wave bridge rectifier 2000 uF smoothing capacitor ke zariye 0.5 A load current deta hai. Ripple voltage maloom karein. Hal: Vripple = IDC/(2fC) = 0.5 A / (2 x 50 Hz x 2000 x 10^-6 F) = 0.5/0.2 = 2.5 V.

blocks.title: Dimagh ki kasrat
blocks.text: Cell phones AC jama karte hain ya DC? In ki batteries DC jama karti hain, jo AC se aasani se jama hota hai; grid AC deta hai, is liye phones, laptops aur torches charge karne se pehle rectifier se ise DC banaya jata hai. Kitab yeh bhi batati hai ke jism se guzarta AC dil ki dharkan bigar kar dil ka daura kar sakta hai; mains frequency ke currents khaas taur par khatarnak hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: PN-junction diode rectification, signal clipping, regulation, voltage clamping, signal detection, photovoltaic cells aur roshni nikalne (LEDs) mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Full-wave rectifier ko half-wave se hamwar karna aasan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke pulses dugni dafa aate hain (ripple frequency 2f), is liye capacitor ko pulses ke darmiyan discharge hone ka aadha waqt milta hai aur usi capacitor ke saath ripple taqreeban aadha hota hai.

blocks.text: Fauri khulasa

items: Rectification: diodes se AC ko DC (forward bias guzarta).
Half-wave: aik diode, aik aadha chakkar; full-wave bridge: chaar diodes, dono aadhe.
Load ke parallel smoothing capacitor; Vripple = IDC/(2fC).
